long_description:
This speed dating event is for Indian, Desi and South Asian Singles!

About this Event

This speed dating event is for Indian, Desi & South Asian Singles! Speed dating is the most effective way for men and women to meet. Nothin' beats meeting someone face to face in a nice and safe environment.

How does it work?
Women stay seated as men switch tables every seven minutes. You'll chat with around 10 potential love interests, and the next day, we will inform you of any matches (the people you picked who also picked you).

Ages: Women 30 - 45, Men 30 - 45

FAQs
Dress code? There is no strict dress code, but we recommend you dress to make a good first impression.
What time should I arrive? Please arrive at least 15 minutes early to sign in and get situated.
Tickets are only $35. We cannot accept walk-ins because we need to ensure an equal number of men and women. You must RSVP to attend.

Speed dating is a fun and pressure free way to meet Desi singles in New York!

Also check out other in New York, Meetups in New York.
